chapter: Early influences, Oliver date and trombone peers
title: The Oliver date: personnel and credit
summary: He recalls Barbarin, Pops Foster and Luis Russell on the 1928-29 date made under Oliver's name.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You mentioned before that you made your first recording with King Oliver's band.
Were there two trombones in that band?
Who else was in that -- that was in 1928 you said?
Yeah, in 1928, first of 1929. Yeah, we had Paul Bar Marvin on drums and Afs Foster on bass and Luis Russell.
That was with King Oliver or that was with -- was that King Oliver's band?
Yeah, but he was using his band. It wasn't King Oliver's band but the recording date was in his name.
Oh, I see, it was more like he made the date, yeah.
He thought he would be able to play but he weren't able to play so that's when they hired Louis Metcalf to play. But I joined Luis Russell, I forget what year it was. We were playing in the ...
